intro: These articles are for shops that make their own listing photos and short ads. They cover a usable source photo, a spoken clip, a pre-publish check, a launch reveal, and a person wearing the item without a shoot.
Read the piece that matches the job, then make the file in the tool it names. You download it and post it yourself.

faq.q: Where do I start if I am new to this?
faq.a: Start with the photography article if your only asset is a phone photo. Start with the ad article if you already have a clear product photo and need a clip.

faq.q: Do the articles replace the tool pages?
faq.a: No. An article explains the job. The tool page is where the file is made. The link in the article opens that tool.

faq.q: What should I check before I publish?
faq.a: Use the checklist article. Confirm the product matches what you ship, watch a clip more than once, and add prices only after download.

faq.q: Which piece is about a launch?
faq.a: The unboxing article plans three clips around launch day, from one product photo. You add the offer after download.

faq.q: Can I show the item on a person without a shoot?
faq.a: Yes. One article shows how to start from a clear garment photo and describe the person and the setting. Check the fit before you post.

faq.q: How much does a file cost?
faq.a: A clip is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. The cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can I use the same check before every post?
faq.a: Yes. The checklist article is the repeatable review: product match, a second watch for clips, and your own words for any price or claim.
Frame and upload rules live on the platform pages and in the guides. These articles stay on the content job, not the ad-account setup.
